facts.business: MSL Global Limited is engaged in investment activities and is exploring environmental projects in association with social and government organizations, having transitioned from its former securities business.
key_risks: Advance of Rs. 12 Crores to Primus Retail Pvt. Ltd. has become doubtful due to liquidation proceedings
No provision made for doubtful advances despite recoverability concerns
Company does not hold any fixed assets or inventory
History of losses in previous financial years
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013, and details have been disclosed in the Ind AS Financial Statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
